coreCorpus.scope: 11 direct-import and reverse-impact positive/negative pairs plus one cross-language C# reference control

native.build: Windows debug native graph MCP; isolated temporary project/data
checks: Native MCP exposes typed-module and relative-Godot callers and affected tests
Native symbol lookup preserves exact declaration location and body
One running native process refreshes edited imports and renamed targets without stale paths
A restarted native process reads the refreshed versioned disk index
Deleted targets stop being reported as indexed definitions

checks.check: Explicit JavaScript resolves emitted JS and does not substitute a missing .mjs with .mts
Single-quoted res:// preload and script-relative inheritance resolve the expected base script

limits: Compiler/runtime checks validate fixture semantics; Rust graph conformance and mutation tests are separate.
Not a full TypeScript module resolver, GDScript parser, C# compiler or whole-project semantic certification.
Approximate local graph, not complete language/compiler semantics.
Full-line comments are excluded in TS/JS, C# and GDScript. Inline/block comments, multiline strings and dynamic expressions are not fully parsed.
Arbitrary tsconfig paths, bundler overrides, package exports, Godot UID mapping and relative load/preload semantics are outside this checkpoint.
Content refresh still uses file size/mtime; edits preserving both stamps and configuration-only graph changes are not certified.
No universal graph accuracy, token saving, model-quality improvement or index-speed gain is inferred from this fixed corpus.
Native validation is Windows debug/MCP with isolated fixtures; other desktop environments remain separate.
